name: groundZero
title: Ground Zero
desc:
The optimal location to begin once more. Low enemy threat. Few resources.

Gather as much lead and copper as possible.
Move on.

name: frozenForest
title: Frozen Forest
desc:
Even here, closer to mountains, the spores have spread. The frigid temperatures cannot contain them forever.

Begin the venture into power. Build combustion generators. Learn to use menders.

name: crateredBattleground
title: Cratered Battleground
desc: Water has accumulated in this crater, relic of the old wars. Reclaim the area. Collect sand. Smelt metaglass. Pump water to cool turrets and drills.

name: ruinousShores
title: Ruinous Shores
desc:
Past the wastes, is the shoreline. Once, this location housed a coastal defense array. Not much of it remains. Only the most basic defense structures have remained unscathed, everything else reduced to scrap.

Continue the expansion outwards. Rediscover the technology.

name: windsweptIslands
title: Windswept Islands
desc:
Further past the shoreline is this remote chain of islands. Records show they once had structures producing Plastanium.

Fend off the enemy's naval units. Establish a base on the islands. Research these factories.

name: saltFlats
title: Salt Flats
desc:
On the outskirts of the desert lie the Salt Flats. Few resources can be found in this location.

The enemy has erected a resource storage complex here. Eradicate their core. Leave nothing standing.

name: tarFields
title: Tar Fields
desc:
The outskirts of an oil production zone, between the mountains and desert. One of the few areas with usable tar reserves.
Although abandoned, this area has some dangerous enemy forces nearby. Do not underestimate them.

Research oil processing technology if possible.

name: impact0078
title: Impact 0078
desc:
Here lie remnants of the interstellar transport vessel that first entered this system.

Salvage as much as possible from the wreckage. Research any intact technology.

name: desolateRift
title: Desolate Rift
desc:
An extremely dangerous zone. Plentiful resources, but little space. High risk of destruction.

Build air and ground defenses as soon as possible. Do not be fooled by the infrequent nature of enemy attacks.

name: planetaryTerminal
title: Planetary Launch Terminal
desc:
The final objective.

This coastal base contains a structure capable of launching Cores to local planets. It is extremely well guarded.

Produce naval units. Eliminate the enemy as quickly as possible. Research the launch structure.

name: coastline
title: Humid Coastline
desc:
Remnants of alloy synthesis technology have been detected at this location.

Repel the enemy attacks, capture this sector, and acquire the technology.

name: testingGrounds
title: Testing Grounds
desc:
[optional objective]
A crater-riddled desert valley, formerly used as a testing ground for military projects.

Due to lack of water, establishing a presence in this location may pose a challenge. Be prepared for attacks from multiple directions.

name: navalFortress
title: Naval Fortress
desc: The enemy has established a base on a remote, naturally-fortified island. Destroy this outpost. Acquire their advanced naval craft technology, and research it.

name: sunkenPier
title: Sunken Pier
desc:
[optional objective]
Once an offshore oil platform, this facility has long-since fallen into disrepair.

High amounts of enemy naval units detected. Be prepared for attacks from multiple directions.

name: weatheredChannels
title: Weathered Channels
desc:
[optional objective]
This channel system harbors abundant resources. Land your core. Fend off the enemy waves to claim them.

The enemy will take multiple routes to assault your infrastructure. Look for signs of a possible ambush and defend accordingly.

name: biomassFacility
title: Biomass Synthesis Facility
desc:
The origin of spores. This is the facility in which they were researched and initially produced.
Research the technology contained within. Cultivate spores for the production of fuel and plastics.

Upon this facility's demise, the spores were released. Nothing in the local ecosystem could compete with such an invasive organism.

name: stainedMountains
title: Stained Mountains
desc:
Further inland lie the mountains, yet untainted by spores.
Extract the abundant titanium in this area. Learn how to use it.

The enemy presence is greater here. Do not give them time to send their strongest units.

name: facility32m
title: Facility 32 M
desc:
This sector contains the moldering remnants of an explosives production facility.

Capture this area. Research the Blast Mixer. Produce Blast Compound for use as turret ammunition.

name: infestedCanyons
title: Infested Canyons
desc:
Beyond the mountains lies a winding river valley, now covered in layers of spore moss.

Hold your ground against the enemy onslaught. Construct naval units. Eliminate all enemy cores.

name: nuclearComplex
title: Nuclear Production Complex
desc:
A former facility for the production and processing of thorium, reduced to ruins.
Research the Thorium Reactor, and utilize it for advanced power generation.

The enemy is present here in great numbers, constantly scouting for attackers.

name: taintedWoods
title: Tainted Woods
desc:
[optional objective]
Rich in oil reserves, this sector contains large masses of fungal growth, making it difficult to traverse.

Utilize its resources to produce Plastanium. Fend off the enemy.

name: fungalPass
title: Fungal Pass
desc:
A transition area between high mountains and lower, spore-ridden lands. A small enemy reconnaissance base is located here.

Utilize Dagger units. Destroy the enemy outpost.

name: frontier
title: Frontier
desc:
A small enemy outpost has been detected here.

Build Mono units in order to harvest resources more effectively. Utilize the Additive Reconstructor to construct stronger units.

name: perilousHarbor
title: Perilous Harbor
desc:
Multiple enemy bases have been established across this treacherous coastal region.

Construct naval units, and crush their fortifications.

name: extractionOutpost
title: Extraction Outpost
desc:
A remote outpost, constructed by the enemy for the purpose of launching resources to other sectors.

Cross-sector transport technology is essential for further conquest. Destroy the base. Research their Launch Pads.

name: atolls
title: Atolls
desc:
[optional objective]
Multiple enemy naval bases have been detected at this location.

Utilize Mega payload units to transport ground forces into attack positions. Build naval units to destroy the peripheral outposts.

name: overgrowth
title: Overgrowth
desc:
This area is overgrown, closer to the origin of the spores.

The enemy has established an outpost here. Build Mace units. Destroy it.

name: mycelialBastion
title: Mycelial Bastion
desc:
This fortified complex lies deep within the fungal regions, threatening neighboring sectors with advanced insectoid units.

Assault the complex. Obtain the technology within. Utilize units capable of traversing walls.

name: littoralShipyard
title: Littoral Shipyard
desc:
Located upon the far reaches of the central sea, this naval production facility contains technology for building advanced units.

Destroy this facility, and use its technology to further assist in the completion of the final objective.
